title: Full Forward Positioning Lead Patterns (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica steel guitar fiddle
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Now pay attention son
A full forward who waits is a full forward who scores
A full forward who runs around aimlessly
That is the other teams fullback sorted

[Verse 1]
Square lead or diagonal, read the kick
Chest lead or overhead, make it quick
Five metre start before the ball leaves hands
Full forward positioning, understand

Crumb position underneath the contest
Pay it off to the rover at your best
Hold your lead until the ball is released
Then go, full pace, forward unleashed

[Pre-Chorus]
Time the lead, read the kick
Five metres depth then make it quick
Chest or overhead, call the lead
Full forward knows what the moment needs

[Chorus]
Full forward leads, timing is gold
Too early you stop, too late you are told
Five metres back, eyes on the set
Full forward timing, best in the net

[Verse 2]
If the kick is short, crumb off the back
If the kick is long and over, come back
Goal-side position on the third and fourth lead
Full forward reads three plays before they proceed

[Bridge]
Bluey: He has SENSED where that kick is going, already in position
Trevor: His lead timing was calibrated on the third leading pattern, textbook
Chas: Son, I have been telling him since he was six, the ball is coming, be ready before it is

[Chorus]
Full forward leads, timing is gold
Too early you stop, too late you are told
Five metres back, eyes on the set
Full forward timing, best in the net

[Outro]
Read three plays ahead son
Thats my boy
